description: Fungus doesn't think or sleep—it just spreads and devours. The Fun with Fungus deck lets you take the reins of a post-apocalyptic rampage of Thallids, and these freaky fungus fiends won't take "Eeeeewww!" for an answer.

name: Hope's Crusaders
description: Nothing—not even an apocalypse—can keep a noble fighter down, and the "Hope's Crusaders" deck is proof of that. Lead your troops onto the battlefield and give them the one command they want to hear: "Charge!" This deck gives your opponent no good blocking options: Either your creatures will get through, or your opponent's blockers will be overmatched in combat.

name: Reality Fracture
description: The Reality Fracture deck highlights the interaction between suspend and storm. Manipulate the time stream just right, and you'll set up a single, explosive, game-winning turn!

name: Sliver Evolution
description: Slivers share a hive mind. Whatever one thinks, they all think. Whatever one can do, they can all do. Slivers have mutated over the years, and the Sliver Evolution deck shows off their new, deadlier skills. But they still think the same thing they always did: "Smash anything that's not a Sliver."

name: Aurochs Stampede
description: Aurochs like two things: frenzied stampedes and more Aurochs. Neither is in short supply during their winter migration-- and during an ice age, winter never ends. Rumble along with the herd that puts the "wild" back in wildlife.

name: Beyond the Grave
description: Everything is scarce during an ice age except snow and death, which makes it a great time to be a necromancer! Slay your own minions for fun and profit, because their deaths unleash your power-- and resurrect your recover cards.

name: Kjeldoran Cunning
description: The formidable Kjeldoran army reached the height of its power during the ice age. Enlist to learn the secrets of their battle tactics, including the crafty ripple mechanic that can magnify your spells two-, three-, or even fourfold.

name: Snowscape
description: There's an old saying about life during an ice age: Those that adapt survive, but those that harness its chill power to fuel their cryptic magic thrive. Join the Rimewind mages deep amid the snow-covered terrain.

name: Azorius Ascendant
description: The Azorius guild is the ruling class of Ravnica, and they're not just above the law-- they're above everything. As they tangle their foes in bureaucracy and red tape, they soar freely over the city. The forecast ability just makes them more insufferable.

name: Rakdos Bloodsport
description: The Rakdos guild goes on killing sprees like people people go on shopping sprees, spreading mayhem across the city for the pure joy of it. As the hellbent mechanic proves, action-- frenzied, violent action-- is far more important than thought.

name: Code of the Orzhov
description: The Orzhov guild is in the habit of making offers its enemies can't refuse. Led by sinister undead advisors, it demands loyalty at all costs. The haunt mechanic merely increases the influence the dead maintain over the affairs of the living.

name: Gruul Wilding
description: The savage Gruul guild runs purely on instinct-- instinct for the hunt. Creatures with the bloodthirst mechanic are fueled by successful raids as the clan wages its frenzied sweep across the landscape. The hunger never stops, and neither do they.

name: Izzet Gizmometry
description: The mad scientists of the Izzet guild are always running experiments to find the next breakthrough in weird science. The replicate mechanic, which turns a single spell into a cluster of them, is the latest weapon in their toy box of magical technology.

name: Charge of the Boros
description: The Boros guild, the most militant force in Ravnica, is always ready for battle. The radiance mechanic lets them level swaths of the unworthy all at once. And if there isn't a fight to join, they're likely to just start one themselves.

name: Dimir Intrigues
description: The Dimir guild is quiet and unassuming... so it's clearly running everything from behind the scenes. The transmute mechanic is just one way they manipulate their own fates. How they pull their enemies' puppet strings is truly wicked.

name: Golgari Deathcreep
description: The Golgari guild turns life into death, and vice versa. The dredge mechanic recycles treasures from the graveyard... while making that graveyard even fatter with loot. The rotting compost carcasses of zombie plants never smelled so sweet.

name: Selesnya United
description: The Selesnya guild values the life of each living thing-- and it will overwhelm anyone who doesn't. The convoke mechanic is just one way it produces new creatures at a massive rate, ensuring all enemies will soon be outnumbered.

name: Army of Justice
description: Fight the good fight with righteous Clerics, Soldiers, and Angels. Use cards that boost your life total to laugh off attacks, then build up your forces and swarm in for victory with your horde.

name: Custom Creatures
description: Take what's good and make it better! The wide array of enchantments in this deck enhances your Elves and Wurms, turning them into unstoppable monstrosities. If they who have the biggest creatures win, your games will be no contest.

name: Dead Again
description: In the "Dead Again" deck, life begins at death. The deck uses your life total and your graveyard as extra resources. It even uses your opponent's life total as a resource!

name: Lofty Heights
description: This deck's dazzling array of flying creatures soars over unsuspecting opponents' heads and leaves them feeling blue. And the sheer number of extra cards you'll be drawing means you'll never fall behind.

name: World Aflame
description: Nothing your opponent plays-- creatures, artifacts, or even lands-- is safe from this deck's destructive spells. After the game, you can roast marshmallows over the smoldering crater on the other side of the table.

name: Critical Mass
description: Sometimes not playing your cards can be more powerful than playing them. Creatures and spells that reward you for a full hand are coupled with devastating sweep cards that rebuild your resources while demolishing your opponent's.

name: Soratami's Wisdom
description: Do you think you're smarter than your opponent? If you're playing the Soratami's Wisdom deck, you probably are! This deck focuses on two things: creatures and spells that get better the more cards you have in your hand, and spells and abilities that fill your hand with cards. Fueled by the massive brainpower of a giant grip of cards, your fleet of fliers and arsenal of combat tricks will let you outsmart anyone who challenges you.

name: Spirit Flames
description: Pound your enemies senseless with kami of forest and flame! Your devious channel creatures will surprise your opponents and then return to wreak more havoc as the soulshift ability renews your horde.

name: Truth Seekers
description: The best offense is a good defense-- so say the wise. Bounteous Kirin leads an impressive array of life-gaining spells that let you hang back and exhaust your opponent. When the dust settles, winning is but a formality.

name: Dark Devotion
description: In the shadowy places of Kamigawa, fanatical ogre shamans lead their cults in worship of twisted demon spirits. Employ your own ogre-magic to summon vile fiends such as Yukora, the Prisoner to do your bidding.

name: Ninjutsu
description: Assassins, Spies, Saboteurs. By any name they are ninja, mysterious masters of concealment and infiltration. The deadly ninjutsu mechanic lets you slip them past enemy lines, and once they're through, the real havoc begins.

name: Rat's Nest
description: For years the ratfolk of the Takenuma Swamp have warred with neighboring realms; now their own kami-- Patron of the Nezumi-- has come to grant them newfound strength. Fast creatures and discard make sure you win the rat race!

name: Spiritcraft
description: Each kami in the spirit world is in tune with each other kami, their energies flowing together in an arcane magical dance. The "spiritcraft" and splice mechanics feed off that energy, generating mind-blowing effects for little cost.

name: Kami Reborn
description: Creatures of the spirit world follow their own rules of life and death-- the souls of some kami can pass on to others. The new soulshift mechanic creates your own private revolving door for the spirits of growth and decay.

name: Snake's Path
description: If your opponents weren't afraid of snakes before, the "Snake's Path" deck will give them a new phobia! With tons of sss-slithery creatures with sss-super abilities, you will sss-seize control in mere sss-seconds!

name: Spiritbane
description: The yamabushi are mountain shamans skilled in the destructive magic needed to combat the spirit world, and the "Spiritbane" deck proves it. With nearly a third of its creatures and spells capable of dealing direct damage, this deck should have no trouble dispatching your opponents and their creatures.

name: Way of the Warrior
description: The "Way of the Warrior" deck enlists a new brigade into your army: Samurai! These fearless warriors showcase the Champions of Kamigawa set's new combat ability: bushido. Whenever a creature with bushido 1 blocks or becomes blocked, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn. Some creatures have bushido 2, or even more. This evocative talent comes as standard for Samurai, and that makes them a force to be reckoned with. Since the bushido bonus is given on both offense and defense, your side should always have the upper hand in battle.

name: Nuts and Bolts
description: Small, inexpensive artifacts have been staples of the Magic game since its earliest days, but the Fifth Dawn expansion boosts their usefulness to another level. Cards like Auriok Salvagers and Leonin Squire bring cheap artifacts back from your graveyard and apply early attacking pressure. With sixteen artifacts that cost {1} or less, the Nuts and Bolts deck takes full advantage of your creatures' scavenging abilities.

name: Special Forces
description: The creatures of the "Special Forces" deck are all mission specialists - the attackers have huge power and the blockers have enormous toughness. Creatures like Dross Crocodile, Plasma Elemental, and Emissary of Despair inflict devastating damage, while Steel Wall and Arachnoid hold down a rock-solid defense.

name: Stampede
description: h, the purity of good ol' red-green beatdown. The "Stampede" deck contains some of the Mirrodin block's finest face-stompers, all ready and waiting to apply hurt to your opponents.

name: Sunburst
description: Use mana-filtering cards to get the most from the Fifth Dawn set's sunburst cards. Pay for your artifacts with different colors of mana and sunburst artifacts reward you with raw power.

name: Master Blaster
description: Wear your opponents down by picking off their cards one by one, while at the same time playing indestructible cards of your own.

name: Mind Swarm
description: Take the fight right to your opponent's hand using a vicious combo of creatures, spells, and Equipment. Talk about hand-to-hand combat!

name: Swarm and Slam
description: Swarm your opponents with creatures and creature tokens, and then screw 'em up with a devastating Echoing Courage, which gives all same-named creatures a boost.

name: Transference
description: If one of your modular creatures is destroyed, make your opponent pay dearly by using that creature's +1/+1 counters to pump up another artifact creature.

name: Bait & Bludgeon
description: With "Bait & Bludgeon," your opponent will have to develop an affinity for punishment or suffer the consequences. This deck is heavy with the new affinity cards, which cost less to play for each aftifact you control.

name: Little Bashers
description: The right tools can make a big difference. "Little Bashers" has a mass of small creatures that when armed with Equipment, will mess your opponent up.

name: Sacrificial Bam
description: Make an inhuman sacrifice and be rewarded. Send artifacts to your graveyard and pump up creatures, or make your opponent lose life and then lose it altogether.

name: Wicked Big
description: The point of "Wicked Big"? Creatures destroy real good. While some decks are heavy with artifacts, this one is big. And wicked. With creatures. Lots and lots of creatures. Bad ones, too. Get it? Good.

name: Expulsion
description: This deck has lots of ways to make opponents discard cards-- and to punish them for doing it. It's all about throwing out the trash and then throwing down the smack.

name: Heavy Hitters
description: Size up your opponents, and then cut them down with a heap of big, fat creatures. With lots of ways to get mana quickly, this deck makes it easy for you to start the beatdown ASAP.

name: Life Boost
description: Live it up with the "Life Boost" deck. Lay down cards to increase your life total, or use your creatures to hold opposing creatures at bay while you take your opponents apart.

name: Sky Slam
description: Ground creatures can only stand by helplessly unable to block your soaring agents of destruction. With all its counters and bounce spells, this deck will make your opponent's head spin.

name: Speed Scorch
description: Size doesn't always count. But numbers do, and this deck proves it. Burn away enemy creatures and then swarm your opponent with this loaded deck of small, speedy Goblins.

name: Goblin Mob
description: Goblin Mob swarms with aggressive goblins. Red goblin tribal at its finest.

name: Max Attax
description: Max Attax goes all-in on massive creatures. Green-black fatties end games decisively.

name: Pulverize
description: Pulverize combines storm magic with burn. Build up spell count for devastating finishes.

name: Storm Surge
description: Storm Surge rides the wave of spells. Blue-white storm with protective magic.

name: Elvish Rage
description: Play some quick Elves and blitz. Then play even more Elves and swarm. Then supersize your Elves and overwhelm! Your opponent will be reeling and feeling the hurt.

name: Morph Mayhem
description: Morph Mayhem hides threats face-down. Flip creatures at opportune moments for maximum impact.

name: Sliver Shivers
description: A fan favorite returns-- the Slivers are loose! Each Sliver splices its own ability onto all other Slivers in play. And now, some even power up Slivers in your hand. Team up and take down.

name: Zombies Unleashed
description: The undead are ready to recruit some new members. Zombies with amplify, morph, and other nasty surprises will drag your opponent's creatures-- and your opponent-- deep into the abyss.

name: Bait & Switch
description: Bait & Switch uses morph creatures to deceive opponents. Flip your creatures at the perfect moment.

name: Celestial Assault
description: Celestial Assault brings soldiers and angels to war. Blue-white tribal aggression.

name: Devastation
description: Devastation unleashes primal fury. Green beasts and red burn devastate all opposition.

name: Ivory Doom
description: Ivory Doom combines clerics with dark magic. White-black tribal control.

name: Air Razers
description: The blitz is on! Score direct hits that obliterate everything in your way. Then reload with card drawing and deck manipulation. The "Air Razers" deck pounds your opponents into the ground.

name: Inundation
description: Inundation floods the board with white creatures. Threshold unlocks even greater power.

name: Painflow
description: Painflow deploys threshold creatures. Fill your graveyard to unlock their full power.

name: Spectral Slam
description: Scare your opponents out of their wits with Phantoms-- nearly invincible creatures that just refuse to go away. The "Spectral Slam" deck will leave your enemies quaking with fear.

name: Grave Danger
description: Turn your graveyard into a resource. The "Grave Danger" deck makes your opponents pay dearly for each card in your graveyard, leaving their creatures bruised and confused.

name: Insanity
description: Insanity embraces madness. Discard for value and deploy threats that love the graveyard.

name: Sacrilege
description: Sacrilege profits from death. White-black sacrifice themes generate value from dying creatures.

name: Waking Nightmares
description: Waking Nightmares brings terror to opponents. Black's nightmares combine with red's fury.

name: Finkel
description: Jon Finkel's black-red deck from Deckmasters 2001. Necropotence powers this aggressive deck designed by one of Magic's greatest players.

name: Garfield
description: Richard Garfield's red-green deck from Deckmasters 2001. Efficient creatures and burn spells in a classic design by Magic's creator.

name: Liftoff
description: Liftoff takes to the skies with flying creatures. Blue-white tempo with evasive threats.

name: One-Two Punch
description: One-Two Punch delivers a devastating combination. Green creatures and red burn finish games fast.

name: Pressure Cooker
description: Pressure Cooker builds up to an explosive finish. Red-black aggression with sacrifice themes.

name: Trounce-O-Matic
description: Innocent little forest creatures become raging monstrosities when you cross the threshold. With the "Trounce-O-Matic" deck, your weenies morph into meanies with the help of deck-filtering cards that fill up your graveyard.

name: Burial
description: Burial brings creatures back from the dead. Graveyard recursion in three colors.

name: Pandemonium
description: Pandemonium brings chaos to the battlefield. Five-color madness with powerful multicolored spells.

name: Swoop
description: Swoop attacks from above with flying creatures. Blue-green tempo with evasive threats.

name: Whirlpool
description: Whirlpool churns through your deck for answers. Blue-red card selection and burn.

name: Armada
description: With "Armada," a strong defense is a strong offense. Maintain order with this white deck filled with quick creatures, powerful healing, and some unique creatures with equally unique abilities. Or just destroy opponents by making your own Serra Angel.

name: Bomber
description: For heads-up play, take off with the blue "Bomber" deck. Launch aerial assaults. Rain havoc on your opponents. When faced with your damaging flying creatures, opponents will be running for cover.

name: Decay
description: Live dangerously with "Decay," a deck that features the best qualities of black: death and disease. Hand destruction, creature destruction, and deadly spells make this one nasty deck.

name: Infestation
description: When it comes time for unbridled aggression, see red with "Infestation." This Goblin-heavy deck has what it takes to beat down your opponent or remove creatures. It also features some gigantic, deadly creature just chomping at the bit to close in for the kill.

name: Way Wild
description: In a world where everything is either prey or predator, only the strong survive. That's why the "Way Wild" deck has big green creatures and lots of them. It also has ways of making your creatures even bigger, quicker, and easier to defend.

name: Barrage
description: Barrage unleashes a relentless assault. Green creatures and red burn combine for explosive damage.

name: Comeback
description: Comeback recovers from any situation. Card advantage and resilient threats grind out victories.

name: Domain
description: The "Domain" deck lets you bring out all five basic land types in your first few turns, placing your rivals in dangerous territory. And the more lands you get into play, the nastier your spells become.

name: Scout
description: Scout explores all angles of attack. Three-color aggression with versatile threats.

name: Blowout
description: Blowout explodes with red-black aggression. Burn spells and aggressive creatures end games fast.

name: Dismissal
description: Dismissal bounces and destroys threats while evasive creatures deal damage. Classic blue-black control.

name: Heavy Duty
description: Heavy Duty deploys efficient green-white creatures. Solid bodies and combat tricks win through quality.

name: Spectrum
description: Spectrum harnesses all five colors of magic. Domain cards grow stronger with each basic land type you control.

name: Aerodoom
description: A blue-black control deck from Beatdown. Survive early with removal, then dominate the skies with Drakes, Djinns, and Elementals.

name: Ground Pounder
description: A red-green beatdown deck from Beatdown. Features the biggest, baddest creatures including Shivan Dragon and Force of Nature.

name: Distress
description: Distress grinds opponents down with removal and life drain. Inevitability through attrition.

name: Pummel
description: The bigger they come, the harder they fall on your opponents. That's the basic idea of the "Pummel" deck, with some of the most powerful Prophecy brutes waiting for thumpin' to happen.

name: Slither
description: Slither combines green's creatures with red's aggression. Fast, efficient, and deadly.

name: Turnaround
description: Turnaround reverses your opponent's momentum. Blue-white control stabilizes the board and takes over.

name: Breakdown
description: Breakdown combines blue control with green creatures. Counter threats and overwhelm with efficient beaters.

name: Eruption
description: Eruption explodes with aggressive creatures and direct damage. Fast and furious, this deck ends games quickly.

name: Mercenaries
description: With "Mercenaries," you enlist an infantry of vile fiends to do your bidding. Where there is one, there are many as you use these creatures' recruiting ability to spawn other monstrosities until the victory is secured.

name: Replicator
description: Your opponents will have double the trouble defending against the duplicating creatures of "Replicator". What little more it costs to play these harbingers of doom is well worth the suffering they inflict.

name: Chargoyf
description: A red-green deck from Battle Royale featuring the mighty Lhurgoyf. Aggressive creatures and burn combine for a powerful assault.

name: Cinder Heart
description: A black-red deck from Battle Royale focused on reanimation and board control. Pestilence and powerful creatures dominate.

name: Spirit Gale
description: A white-blue control deck from Battle Royale. Flying creatures, counterspells, and Wrath of God make for a powerful combination.

name: The Deluge
description: A green-white deck from Battle Royale featuring big creatures and Land Tax. Spike creatures grow your army to overwhelm opponents.

name: Deepwood Menace
description: Deepwood Menace unleashes the dangers of the Deepwood. Aggressive creatures and combat tricks crush unprepared opponents.

name: Disrupter
description: Lay down some good old-fashioned, gruesome carnage. The "Disrupter" is all about punishment and pain, with land and hand destruction galore.

name: Rebel's Call
description: Rebel's Call assembles an army of Rebels. Search your deck for the right soldier at the right time.

name: Tidal Mastery
description: Tidal Mastery commands the seas. Blue-white control with powerful flying creatures dominates the battlefield.

name: Blinding Fury
description: Blinding Fury harnesses white creature abilities. Expanded gameplay with this white theme deck.

name: Deadly Instinct
description: Deadly Instinct embraces dark power. Black creature abilities and removal.

name: Goblin Assault
description: Goblin Assault brings the heat. Red direct damage and fast creatures.

name: Impaler
description: Impaler commands nature's might. Green's biggest, baddest creatures.

name: Time Curse
description: Time Curse controls the flow of time. Blue spell-denial and tempo.

name: Assassin
description: Send in a swarm of small, black creatures backed up with creature destruction and discard effects. You'll put a hit on your opponent's offense and keep it on the run. "Assassin" will take your opponent down.

name: Enchanter
description: The Enchanter deck weaves powerful auras onto creatures. Transform humble beings into unstoppable forces.

name: Shu Kingdom
description: A white deck from Portal Three Kingdoms featuring the noble Liu Bei and his legendary oath-brothers. Horsemanship creatures evade blockers.

name: Wei Kingdom
description: A black deck from Portal Three Kingdoms ruled by the cunning Cao Cao. Assassins and disruption crush your enemies.

name: Wu Kingdom
description: A blue deck from Portal Three Kingdoms led by the wise Sun Quan. Control magic and counterspells protect your horsemanship army.

name: Battle Surge
description: Use blue stalling tactics to hold off the opposition. Then lay down a host of red creatures without summoning sickness to mount a decisive attack. "Battle Surge" will turn the tide of war in your favor.

name: Crusher
description: Before Urza can complete the Legacy and build the famed ship Weatherlight, the planeswalker must overcome some large obstacles: hulking worms and treefolk. They're big, they're bad, and they're worth the wait. Once you bring them out, "Crusher" is bound to leave your opponents hurting.

name: Fiendish Nature
description: Use fast mana sources to power up a horde of big, green uglies with attitude. A touch of black regrowth keeps the hits coming. "Fiendish Nature" will give your game a mean streak.

name: Phyrexian Assault
description: While Urza builds his Legacy and the famed ship Weatherlight, he must defend against an onslaught of foul beasts. "Phyrexian Assault" gives you an unending barrage of creatures and creature removal cards that can quickly break down even the most formidable defense.

name: Radiant's Revenge
description: Before Urza can complete the famed ship Weatherlight, he must face the new ruler of Serra's realm, an archangel hell-bent on revenge. "Radiant's Revenge" is a time bomb that explodes with card-drawing and control cards.

name: Time Drain
description: As Urza builds his Legacy by completing the famed ship Weatherlight, an unlikely band of faeries aids him. Use legions of free creatures and cycling cards in "Time Drain" to crush your opponents before they have a chance to prepare for battle. Make sure time is on your side.

name: Dark Alliance
description: A black-red aggressive deck from Anthologies. Goblins swarm the battlefield while Hypnotic Specter disrupts opponent's plans.

name: Defenders of the Cause
description: A green-white control deck from Anthologies. Establish ground stalemates while winning through aerial superiority with Serra Angel.

name: Sleeper
description: Take control of the field with this innovative white creature deck. When the "Sleeper" awakens, your enchantments will transform into powerful creatures.

name: Special Delivery
description: Special Delivery brings the biggest creatures to the battlefield fast. Ramp into massive threats and deliver the beatdown.

name: The Plague
description: The Plague deck weaponizes Pestilence to sweep the board repeatedly while your creatures survive the onslaught.

name: Tombstone
description: In this black and blue deck, cycling cards give you options while reanimation cards bring back the pain. Over and over.

name: Goblin Fire
description: Goblin Fire unleashes destruction. Red goblins and burn spells.

name: Martial Law
description: Martial Law enforces order. White soldiers and griffins maintain peace.

name: Nature's Assault
description: Nature's Assault summons the wild. Green creatures and natural magic.

name: Nightstalkers
description: Nightstalkers lurk in shadows. Black discard and creature destruction.

name: Spellweaver
description: Spellweaver controls the battlefield. Blue magic and card advantage.

name: Dominator
description: The Dominator deck establishes complete control over the game. Counter spells, bounce permanents, and dominate the board with evasive creatures.

name: Groundbreaker
description: With massive land-destruction capability, "Groundbreaker" will keep your opponent powerless until you've set up the finishing blow. Explore the strength of "Groundbreaker" and leave your opponent in the dirt.

name: White Heat
description: White Heat combines efficient white creatures with red's direct damage. Swarm the board and burn away any resistance.

name: Widowmaker
description: Widowmaker uses blue-black control to slowly strangle opponents. Card advantage and removal ensure victory through attrition.

name: Call of the Kor
description: The en-Kor nomads have mastered the art of redirecting damage. Call of the Kor assembles these warriors to protect each other while striking at foes.

name: Migraine
description: In the second episode of the Rath Cycle, Gerrard and the heroes of the Weatherlight penetrate Volrath's stronghold on the plane of Rath. With discard spells and fast creatures, "Migraine" gives you control of one valuable resource. Your opponent's mind.

name: The Sparkler
description: The Sparkler combines blue control magic with red direct damage. Counter threats and burn your opponents with lightning and fire.

name: The Spikes
description: In the second episode of the Rath Cycle, Gerrard and the heroes of the Weatherlight confront perplexing powers inside Volrath's stronghold. "The Spikes" introduces new creatures that sling counters around the table, creating fresh strategies and unique situations.

name: Deep Freeze
description: On the shadow plane of Rath, the flying ship Weatherlight encounters chilling new forces of magic. "Deep Freeze" uses new Tempest cards to set up your opponent's permanents, then lock them down. When you want to be cold and calculating, bring out the "Deep Freeze."

name: The Flames of Rath
description: The Flames of Rath deck harnesses the power of fire and fury. With Furnace of Rath doubling all damage, burn your opponents to cinders.

name: The Slivers
description: The Slivers are a hive-minded race of creatures that share abilities. Build your swarm and watch as each Sliver makes all others more powerful.

name: The Swarm
description: From the shadow plane of Rath emerges "The Swarm," a preconstructed deck designed to engulf your opponents with a relentless army of creatures. Loaded with strategy and packed with new creatures, "The Swarm" is fast, furious, and fun.

name: Air Forces
description: Air Forces takes to the skies. Blue-white flying creatures dominate.

name: Dead and Alive
description: Dead and Alive blurs the line. Black reanimation and graveyard themes.

name: Fiery Fury
description: Fiery Fury burns everything. Mono-red burn and aggressive creatures.

name: Gatecrasher
description: Gatecrasher smashes through defenses. Green-red aggression breaks down doors.

name: Legion of Glory
description: Legion of Glory marches to war. White weenie with flanking knights.

name: Savage Stompdown
description: Savage Stompdown crushes opponents. Green creatures and red burn in harmony.

name: Unnatural Forces
description: Unnatural Forces wields strange magic. Blue-black control with unusual threats.

name: Wild-Eyed Frenzy
description: Wild-Eyed Frenzy attacks relentlessly. Mono-red aggression with flanking.

name: Burning Sky
description: Burning Sky combines blue tempo with red burn. Counter and burn your way to victory.

name: Jungle Jam
description: Jungle Jam deploys Jamuraan creatures. Green-white beatdown from the wilds.

name: Night Terrors
description: Night Terrors brings darkness to Jamuraa. Black control with discard and removal.

name: Ride Like the Wind
description: Ride Like the Wind charges with flanking knights. Red-white aggression at its fastest.

name: Quick Start Set: Rivals
description: Magic: The Gathering is set in the imaginary worlds of Dominia, where powerful wizards battle for control of the landscape. The rival twin wizards, Kazz and Zakk, will lead you through your first game of Magic. Powerful creatures and spells are at your disposal, which you use to reduce your opponent's 20 life to zero. If you accomplish this first, you've won the game!

name: Aura of Courage
description: Stand tall next to Galea and arm your forces with powerful Auras and Equipment. With a paladin's protection on your side, none shall do you harm.
